video_summary.overall_goal: Navigate podcast app to browse and play a podcast episode
video_summary.description: User starts with onboarding dialog, navigates through home, queue, and subscriptions tabs to find and play a podcast

steps.what_screen_is_visible: AntennaPod onboarding dialog overlay on top of app. Shows welcome message 'Welcome to AntennaPod' and action buttons 'Unsubscribe' and primary button
visible_ui_elements: Description: 'Easy-to-use, flexible and open-source podcast manager and player'
steps.visual_feedback: Dialog overlay visible with semi-transparent background

steps.what_screen_is_visible: AntennaPod home tab with welcome message and icon. Bottom navigation visible with Home tab highlighted
visible_ui_elements: Welcome icon and text 'Welcome to AntennaPod'
Subtitle: 'The easiest way to subscribe to your favourite podcasts'
Bottom navigation: Home, Queue, Downloads, Subscriptions, Profile
steps.system_response: Home tab becomes active after onboarding dialog dismissal
steps.visual_feedback: Home screen fully displayed with navigation active

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Queue tab selected in bottom navigation. Screen shows 'Queue' header with empty state message: 'No episodes in queue, add new from your podcast list'
visible_ui_elements: Message about adding episodes from podcast list
steps.system_response: Switches to Queue tab, displays empty state

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Subscriptions tab selected. Shows empty state with message: 'No subscriptions. To subscribe, press the icon below'
visible_ui_elements: Subscriptions tab (active in bottom navigation, highlighted in blue)
Text: 'No subscriptions. To subscribe, press the icon below'
steps.system_response: Switches to Subscriptions tab, displays empty state

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Add Podcast dialog or screen. Shows podcast search with 'LARGE FITS' visible and action buttons. Podcast list with entries visible: 'The Brightest Star 51:33 00' and other episodes
visible_ui_elements: Episode listings with titles and durations
steps.system_response: Opens add podcast dialog with search interface and results
steps.visual_feedback: Dialog or overlay appears with podcast discovery content

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Podcast detail page with 'Bridge of Lies' podcast displayed. Shows podcast artwork, title, episode list, and playback controls at bottom. Player bar shows track info and play/pause buttons
visible_ui_elements: Episode list with titles and durations
steps.system_response: Navigates to podcast detail screen, displays full podcast info and episodes
steps.visual_feedback: Podcast detail page fully loaded with artwork and player visible
steps.intent_task: View podcast episodes and play audio

overall_flow: User views podcast detail page with player controls
human_readable_step_summary: AntennaPod onboarding dialog appears on app startup.
Home tab displays welcome message and navigation.
User taps Queue tab to view episode queue (empty).
User taps Subscriptions tab to view subscriptions (empty).
User opens add podcast interface to discover and add podcasts.
User navigates to podcast detail page, showing 'Bridge of Lies' podcast with player controls.
